observations.body: A mysterious man wrestles Jacob, wounds him, renames him Israel, and blesses him.
observations.label: Jacob is renamed Israel in a night struggle: action

observations.body: Jacob names the place for seeing God face to face and leaves limping.
observations.label: Jacob is renamed Israel in a night struggle: response

payload.posture: Read Genesis 32:22–32 as a name becomes a people evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The source calls the figure a man while Jacob names the encounter as seeing God, and the new name does not erase Jacob’s old name.
